story_type: boarding team jumps onto a moving narco semi-submersible, helmet cam
hook: He jumped from a speeding boat onto a moving narco sub.
narration: A Coast Guardsman jumped from a speeding boat onto a moving narco sub.
Cutter Munro's boarding team was chasing a self-propelled semi-submersible across the Eastern Pacific.
Boats like this ride almost flush with the sea, built to carry huge loads while evading detection.
The sub kept going, and the waves kept breaking over it.
The small boat pulled right alongside.
[short pause] Then the team got the hatch open.
outcome: The team seized more than seventeen thousand pounds of cocaine from that sub.
title: Jumping onto a moving narco sub
description:
Coast Guard Cutter Munro boarding team members jump aboard a self-propelled semi-submersible suspected of drug smuggling in the Eastern Pacific Ocean, June 18, 2019.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/695886/us-coast-guard-cutter-munro-crew-interdicts-suspected-drug-smuggling-vessel

extra_sources.excerpt: The interdiction of the self-propelled semi-submersible on June 18 th resulted in the removal of over 17000 pounds of cocaine, worth an estimated $232 million, making it the Coast Guard’s largest single seizure since 2015.

facts.claim: SPSSs are built to carry large loads while evading detection
